garden.title: Community Garden Opens Its Gates
garden.author: contributor
garden.content:
Planting day

Volunteers planted forty raised beds on Saturday. Read the garden rota to sign up for watering.

What grows next

Beans, chard and sunflowers go in next month.

market.title: Night Market Returns to Ferry Square
market.author: editor
market.content:
Stalls and opening hours

Twenty stalls open from six until ten on the first Friday of each month.
